When we change our model of theory, we change the way we look at things. Example: given our recent problems of Episteme-Entropy (Information Overload and Uncertainty = Immobilization)... when we switch our perspective, we switch our theory, and we elevate certain values over others.

Value theory

When we shift our theory from detail-oriented (file formats, scalability, stages, unknowns, etc.) to phenomenology-oriented (What format expresses dynamic web content most effectively?) we are essentially unifying the Abstract, Theory, Observation and Problem... all operating at the necessary strata (Phenomenologically)
